name: aleron-physician-portal-designs
description: Static wireframe set for the Aleron MD physician portal, and the Canvas/Junction harness that checks its API claims.
//: A workspace rather than one merged package: these scripts are CommonJS and use require(), while the harness is an ESM Vite/React app that needs "type": "module". Merging the two package.json files would mean rewriting every script in scripts/ for no gain. Workspaces let each keep its own module system under one npm install.
